environment.platform: same x86_64 function-compute container and host, sequential arms

protocol.arms: one old batch followed by one resident batch, no concurrent neural jobs or MPS input transfer on the benchmark host
protocol.baseline: Path-based V5; upstream models, map and retrieval arrays reload naturally within each query, not100separateCLIinvocations
protocol.resident: Map/model preparation once; in-memory queries and a byte-bounded CPU reference-feature cache
protocol.timing: Query and frame-to-result wall times exclude preflight checksums, reference-error calculation and after-clock oracle/report I/O. Old PNG staging is included only in frame-to-result duration.
protocol.filesystem_cache: OS file caches were not flushed; initialization is process/model cold, not physical-disk cold
protocol.reference: Published MPS Multi-SLAM reference; not independent physical ground truth

memory.cache_scope: Retained numerical local-feature array payloads only; not total RSS, reconstruction/global index, models or query tensors

limitations: These are exposed regression queries, not a new blind accuracy study or threshold tuning set.
Results preserve accepted metre-scale and near180degree errors; this optimization is not a reliability fix.
The new fixed-seed Linux run is separate from historical Mac97/100 or the original850-query corpus; neither is overwritten.
Only RGB100-query runtime timing is measured. Four-SLAM preprocessing parity and native gPnP regression are not full rig runtime qualification.
No GPU, Jetson, Mac warm-runtime, physical SDK streaming or cross-day performance is claimed.
A256MiB feature cache increases steady-state memory; the measured peak RSS increased rather than decreased.
Stage medians are not additive; inclusive old stages already contain model initialization and must not be double-counted.
